sup:70110.text:
Guten Tag,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below.

For generations, our foundry has taken great pride in supplying our regional partners with the utmost care and quality. To continue serving you with the craftsmanship you expect from us, we must account for our rising expenses. Over the past twelve months, LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. Furthermore, PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost.

Taking these developments into consideration, we are pleased to present our offer for a price of €138.55 per unit, valid from 1 November 2026. This offer remains valid for 30 days.

We value our long-standing relationship deeply and look forward to continuing our successful cooperation.

Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG

move.body:
Thank you for your offer. We have moved on our side; please see our updated terms.

To support the price in our term sheet:
Your letter gives 51 days of notice for the price change, which falls short of the notice period in our contract (doc:20260911-70110-P01, ctr:4600070110).
Producer prices DE: electric power generation, transmission and distribution changed -3.7% from 2025-08 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-08, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
The cost drivers we track (about 64% of the cost of this part) moved +2.3% weighted over the last twelve months, against the 9.5% you ask.
Labour cost index DE, manufacturing changed +2.7% from 2025-06 to 2026-06 (idx:LCI-C@2025-06, idx:LCI-C@2026-06).
Could you send us a breakdown of the costs behind your price?

move.text:
Guten Tag,
Many thanks for your message; I have read it carefully together with my people here at the foundry, and we have given it the attention it deserves.
We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows.
Our terms: a price of €134.70 per unit, Zahlungsziel 14 days net, valid from 1 November 2026.
Let me tell you how we see it from our side.
As to the index change and notice period data you cited, we did not know that - a fair point.
LCI-C rose 2.7 % in twelve months and is 30 % of our cost. That remains.
PPI-C241 rose 6.5 % in twelve months and is 24 % of our cost. That remains.
We have carefully reviewed your data regarding the energy index and the notice period, and we have adjusted our position to reflect these facts while maintaining the 1 November 2026 effective date.
We accept your proposed 14-day payment terms, which allows us to offer a revised price of €134.70.
Please understand that as a family-owned foundry, we treat our detailed cost structures as strictly confidential and cannot provide the requested breakdown.
Our costs move with LCI-C, PPI-C241, PPI-D351; the figures stay with us.
We have worked together for many years, and I am confident that we will find a fair way forward, as we always have between our two houses.
Viele Grüße aus der Gießerei
Thomas Brandlhuber
Owner, Gießerei Brandlhuber GmbH & Co. KG
